excerpt.zh: 我们的一个潜在目标似乎具有我们需要的科研许可，并且他们对我们伪造的证书深信不疑。这似乎是我们目前最大的优势。
excerpt.en: One of our potential targets seems to have the kind of research clearance we need, and they are suitably impressed by our fabricated credentials. This lead seems our best one for now.

texts.zh: 我们的一个潜在目标似乎具有我们需要的科研许可，并且他们对我们伪造的证书深信不疑。这似乎是我们目前最大的优势。
texts.en: One of our potential targets seems to have the kind of research clearance we need, and they are suitably impressed by our fabricated credentials. This lead seems our best one for now.

texts.zh: 我们已经找到了一个符合我们预期标准的目标：能够获得足够前沿的研究成果，同时对于我们的特工持友好态度。我们将会继续跟进这名领袖。
texts.en: We have found a target who meets our ideal criteria: access to sufficiently novel research, and a receptive attitude towards our operative. We will continue to pursue this lead.

texts.zh: 我们的特工已经找到了缺口——这对于我们渗透连接到[root.target.GetAdj]相关研究的计划来说是一个理想的基石。
texts.en: Our operatives have found an opening - an ideal foundation upon which to build our plans to infiltrate [root.target.GetAdj] research.
